description: This file defines the ConceptValidator class for the OpenMRS project. It provides validation logic for Concept objects, including checks for at least one name, duplicate names, proper naming conventions, and concept mappings.

classes.name: ConceptValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the Concept object, which performs various validation checks on concept data within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if the validator supports the given class type (Concept).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Concept object, checking for name validity, mappings, duplicate names, lengths, and other constraints as per business rules.
